title: Sword Art Online's Echoes of Aincrad Game's New Trailer Previews Death Game Mode
content: Bandai Namco Europe presented a new trailer for the Death Game Mode in Echoes of Aincrad , the new action RPG based on Reki Kawahara 's Sword Art Online franchise, on Tuesday: The game is set in the world of Aincrad, the setting of the original story's eponymous in-story virtual MMO Sword Art Online .
author: ANN

title: Yoroi-Shinden Samurai Troopers Anime's 2nd Part Casts Hina Suguta
content: The staff for Yoroi-Shinden Samurai Troopers , the new sequel anime of the Yoroiden Samurai Troopers series, confirmed on Wednesday that it has cast Hina Suguta as Kaede Narumi, the newly appointed DST commander. The character began appearing in the anime's second cours (quarter of a year) as of episode 13 on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: 16 Years Later, Crunchyroll’s Critically Acclaimed Fantasy Ends Ahead of Season 2
content: Written and illustrated by Kusanagi Mizuho, Yona of the Dawn is one of the most beloved romance fantasy series of all time. The manga began serialization in Hakusensha’s Hana to Yume magazine in 2009 on a monthly schedule.
author: ComicBook

title: Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Reveals Episode Count in Blu-ray Listings: 14 Episodes
content: Blu-ray listings for Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation III (Season 3) reveal that the season will run for at least 14 episodes. The season’s second Blu-ray volume contains Episodes 8 to 14; it’s unconfirmed whether there will be further Blu-ray volumes or episodes.
author: Anime Corner

title: Solo Leveling’s Upcoming Project Shares New Look At Original Story
content: The latest announcement regarding the Solo Leveling film took the internet by storm, as fans were waiting for an anime sequel for more than a year. The second season wrapped up the Jeju Island Arc, where Jinwoo fought against his most powerful opponent yet.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon Ball’s Xenoverse 2 Finale Pays Touching Tribute to Akira Toriyama
content: One of the biggest anime video games of all time is easily Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 , which has continued to release a steady stream of new content for almost a decade following its initial release.

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Gets a Promising Season 3 Update
content: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End is one of the biggest fantasy anime of the 2020s, and it’s all set for its return with Season 3 next year. Fans are already hyped up about the upcoming season since it’s expected to adapt the best manga arc so far.
